div.p: Estate of the late Helena Catharina Krugel, widow of the Rev:d J:W:L: Gebhard.
I. The highest bidder to be the purchaser, and if any dispute should arise between two or more bidders, the lot in dispute to be immediately put up again and re-sold.
II. No Person to advance less than two skillings at each bidding when above Ten Rix-dollars: above Twenty-five Rix-dollars, four skillings: and so on in proportion.
III. All Purchasers must pay a deposit of ten persent, or the whole amount if required, before the lots are removed, and also declare their names and places of abode.

IV. Lots which are allowed to be taken away, to be at the risk of the buyer and to be paid for at No. 4, Burg-street, within three days, either in Cash or Bills to be approved of by the Seller, payable on the fifteenth day of Febr:y next. No Bill will be accepted for a less amount than One Hundred Rix-dollars, or Seven Pounds Ten Shillings Sterling.

V. The lots to be taken away, with all faults and errors of description, after the Sale, at the Purchaser’s expence, and when a deposit has been made the remainder of the purchased money to be paid on or before delivery.
VI. Purchasers neglecting to call for and discharge their accounts within the above period of three days, will be liable to prosecution.
